title: Checkout & payment links
summary: A Stripe-style checkout, payment-link builder and transactions dashboard.
ideas: Add Apple Pay / Google Pay style express buttons and a tip selector
Add refunds: let the merchant refund a payment and show it in the activity feed
Add split payments so a bill can be shared between 3 friends
Add a receipt page the customer can print or email
guide: Pages: src/pages/Checkout.jsx (customer-facing card form with Luhn/expiry validation and a fake processing step), src/pages/Links.jsx (create and toggle payment links), src/pages/Activity.jsx (payments table with status badges). Shared state (payments, links) lives in src/App.jsx. No real payment provider is called; the package @stripe/react-stripe-js is installed if a team wants to wire Stripe Elements with their own test publishable key (never a live key).
